brief.summary: Equity futures point higher, led by a tech and chip rebound after a brutal stretch, with S&P futures up 0.5% and Nasdaq up 1.2%. Rates remain high—2-year near 4.70% and 10-year around 5.1%—while the show describes a tightening cycle that typically flattens the curve. The dominant narrative is mixed: AI capex and tech earnings remain a bullish anchor, but France's riots, wider credit spreads, and elevated oil keep risk appetite constrained. The Fed discussion is hawkish on inflation but the immediate path is unclear. Overall tone is neutral, with guests favoring risk-on tech but wary of Europe and financing stress.
